distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 134.4948 +/- 0.0578 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 7.44 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.6954 +/- 0.0041 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 33: mass 0.753 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 33: effective temperature in K, 4950 +/- 14, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
